hypotheses.claim: Refining the static merge score to balance distance savings against capacity fit will reduce the CVRP objective below the round-1 best of 17.8570 without requiring postprocessing or a template change.

next_search_advice.direction: Tune the static parallel-merge scoring rule to be capacity-aware: prioritize high distance-savings merges, penalize merges that leave residual capacity poorly matched to remaining demand, and use deterministic tie-breaking by route compactness. Explore a small grid of savings weight versus capacity-fit penalty within the existing static merge template.
